recipe.calibration: Set12 01.png, sigma of the network, test_noise seed 0, host emulation
recipe.window_generator: one np.random.default_rng(42) per network, layer order
recipe.objective: mean W=4 window cycles, max(ceil(K/4)+1, ceil(COUT/16)*max(1, max_b nnz_b), COUT)
recipe.search: q1_reviewer_bank.fit_group: identity start, 400 swaps of channels in different classes, accept if the objective falls by > 1e-10, seed 42 + fitted-layer index

recipe.order: position -> original channel; class of position p is p % 4
